<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="lgFzRiSfujaYDgDzemHk"> <mxGraphModel dx="860" dy="439" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml Contenedores
!include https://githubusercontent.com
System_Boundary(sistema_inbox, \"Ecosistema Docker Compose\") {
 Container(ngrok, \"Contenedor ngrok\", \"ngrok:latest\", \"Expone el túnel público.\")
 Container(frontend, \"Frontend App\", \"Angular 19 & Nginx\", \"Interfaz reactiva basada en Signals.\")
 Container(backend, \"WebApi Server\", \".NET 10 WebAPI\", \"Recibe webhooks y expone endpoints REST.\")
 Container(rabbitmq, \"Broker RabbitMQ\", \"RabbitMQ 3-Management\", \"Desacopla mensajes entrantes.\")
 Container(worker, \"Consumidor\", \".NET BackgroundService\", \"Procesa colas y gatilla SignalR.\")
 ContainerDb(postgres, \"Base de Datos\", \"PostgreSQL 15\", \"Persiste contactos y mensajes.\")
}
Rel(ngrok, backend, \"Redirige actualizaciones\", \"HTTP\")
Rel(backend, rabbitmq, \"Publica evento de texto\", \"AMQP\")
Rel(rabbitmq, worker, \"Consume asíncronamente\", \"AMQP\")
Rel(worker, postgres, \"Persiste entidades\", \"EF Core\")
Rel(worker, frontend, \"Empuja datos en tiempo real\", \"SignalR WebSockets\")
Rel(frontend, backend, \"Consume historial y responde\", \"HTTP REST\")
@enduml
",
 "config": null
